content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing issues with Modbus TCP function 06 write operations while using [product_name] [version_no]. I'm trying to get [product_name] ([version_no], FS: 04) to write using Modbus TCP function 06. I've attached the speed change register for a VFD from [company_name]. Reading using function 03 works without problems.
Could you specify what issue you are encountering with function 06?
